verses.1: To David, when he changed his appearance in the sight of Abimelech, and so he dismissed him, and he went away.
verses.2: I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise will be ever in my mouth.
verses.3: In the Lord, my soul will be praised. May the meek listen and rejoice.
verses.4: Magnify the Lord with me, and let us extol his name in itself.
verses.5: I sought the Lord, and he heeded me, and he carried me away from all my tribulations.
verses.6: Approach him and be enlightened, and your faces will not be confounded.
verses.7: This poor one cried out, and the Lord heeded him, and he saved him from all his tribulations.
verses.8: The Angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear him, and he will rescue them.
verses.9: Taste and see that the Lord is sweet. Blessed is the man who hopes in him.
verses.10: Fear the Lord, all you his saints. For there is no destitution for those who fear him.
verses.11: The rich have been needy and hungry, but those who seek the Lord will not be deprived of any good thing.
verses.12: Come forward, sons. Listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.13: Which is the man who wills life, who chooses to see good days?
verses.14: Prohibit your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.15: Turn away from evil, and do good. Inquire about peace, and pursue it.
verses.16: The eyes of the Lord are on the just, and his ears are with their prayers.
verses.17: But the countenance of the Lord is upon those who do evil, to perish the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.18: The just cried out, and the Lord heard them, and he freed them from all their tribulations.
verses.19: The Lord is near to those who are troubled in heart, and he will save the humble in spirit.
verses.20: Many are the afflictions of the just, but from them all the Lord will free them.
verses.21: The Lord preserves all of their bones, not one of them shall be broken.
verses.22: The death of a sinner is very harmful, and those who hate the just will fare badly.
verses.23: The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants, and none of those who hope in him will fare badly. [ Psalm 34 ] (35)
